* 5. build
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: types/build
:FILE: src/graphden/types/validator.clj
:LINE: 160
:MINS: 1.5
:END:

Builds a pure boundary validator from the same supported data declaration used by static checking. Success returns the original value. Failure reports safe path/code diagnostics without rejected contents; unsupported definitions fail construction. The companion checked-type returns the same canonical variant/alias shape used by the ensure-type return rule.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/types/validator.clj::(defn build][src/graphden/types/validator.clj:160]]

* 9. subtype?
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: types/subtype?
:FILE: src/graphden/types/core.clj
:LINE: 1253
:MINS: 13.7
:END:

Tests whether every value allowed by ~actual~ is also allowed by ~expected~. Its ordered cases handle special types, unions, primitives, refinements, structural types, and [[file:glossary.org::#term/secret][secret markers]]. For unions, every actual alternative must fit, while an expected union needs at least one matching alternative. Read the case for the two shapes being compared.

* 11. unify
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: types/unify
:FILE: src/graphden/types/core.clj
:LINE: 1741
:MINS: 10.8
:END:

[[file:glossary.org::#term/unification][Unification]] finds substitutions for [[file:glossary.org::#term/unification][type variables]] that make two type expressions compatible. The [[file:glossary.org::#term/unification][occurs check]] prevents a variable from being defined recursively through itself. Structural cases recurse into function, collection, and record types; the result is a substitution map or ~::fail~. Directional assignability is checked separately.

Checks one [[file:glossary.org::#term/binding][binding]]'s actual type against the [[file:glossary.org::#term/slot][slot]]'s expected type. It combines literal classification, [[file:glossary.org::#term/subtype][subtype]] checks, and type-variable [[file:glossary.org::#term/unification][unification]]. Checks assignment direction after [[file:glossary.org::#term/unification][unification]]. Infers a return type from a [[file:glossary.org::#term/unification][polymorphic signature]] when there is no custom ~:return-type-rule~. Stores each function's computed argument types, return type, and [[file:glossary.org::#term/effect][effects]] in the [[file:glossary.org::#term/rich-types][rich-types registry]]. Compiler decisions, runtime checks, [[file:glossary.org::#term/secret][secret redaction]], and editor labels read this data. Writes target the active branch's registry, so checking one branch does not overwrite another branch's types.
